method: Manual comparison of five rendered frames per preset, nearest-neighbor report, and full MP4 decode

decisions.observation: The late frames retain several offset translucent outlines of the foreground while the sun edge smears across positions. Unlike handheld shake, the previous positions remain visibly layered, creating a recognizable ghost trail.

The late frames switch to a nearly black image with thin white contours around the sun, foreground, and panel; the contour intensity flashes over time. This is visibly distinct from full-color brightness flicker and multicolor glitch effects.
